snippets.name: Expired app credentials
snippets.description: Application secrets and certificates that ended more than the grace period ago, one row per app.
snippets.text:
union
    (applications | mv-expand cred = passwordCredentials | extend credKind = "secret"),
    (applications | mv-expand cred = keyCredentials | extend credKind = "certificate")
| where todatetime(cred.endDateTime) < now() - {graceDays}
| summarize expired = count(), kinds = make_set(credKind) by displayName, appId
| order by expired desc

snippets.name: Passthru apps
snippets.description: Applications published through Application Proxy that let traffic through without Entra pre-authentication.
snippets.text:
applications
| where isnotnull(onPremisesPublishing)
| where tostring(onPremisesPublishing.externalAuthenticationType) == "passthru"
| project displayName, appId, externalUrl = tostring(onPremisesPublishing.externalUrl)

snippets.name: Stale guests
snippets.description: Guest users who have not signed in successfully within the period, or never have. Needs AuditLog.Read.All for signInActivity.
snippets.text:
users
| where userType == "Guest"
| extend lastSignIn = todatetime(signInActivity.lastSuccessfulSignInDateTime)
| where isnull(lastSignIn) or lastSignIn < ago({days})
| project displayName, userPrincipalName, mail, createdDateTime, lastSignIn
| order by lastSignIn asc

snippets.name: Risky service principals
snippets.description: Service principals Entra ID Protection flags as at risk or confirmed compromised.
snippets.text:
identityProtection_riskyServicePrincipals
| where riskState in ("atRisk", "confirmedCompromised")
| project displayName, appId, riskLevel, riskState, riskDetail, riskLastUpdatedDateTime
| order by riskLastUpdatedDateTime desc

snippets.name: Apps with privileged Graph permissions
snippets.description: Applications that request high-privilege Microsoft Graph application permissions, such as RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory or Mail.ReadWrite, one row per app. This reads what each app registration requests, not what an admin has consented to, and apps registered in other tenants are not listed.
snippets.text:
// Application permissions (app roles) on Microsoft Graph that can take over the tenant or reach its data.
applications
| mv-expand rra = requiredResourceAccess
| where tostring(rra.resourceAppId) == "00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000" // Microsoft Graph
| mv-expand access = rra.resourceAccess
| where tostring(access.type) == "Role"
| extend permissionId = tostring(access.id)
| where permissionId in (
    "9e3f62cf-ca93-4989-b6ce-bf83c28f9fe8", // RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory
    "06b708a9-e830-4db3-a914-8e69da51d44f", // AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All
    "1bfefb4e-e0b5-418b-a88f-73c46d2cc8e9", // Application.ReadWrite.All
    "19dbc75e-c2e2-444c-a770-ec69d8559fc7", // Directory.ReadWrite.All
    "62a82d76-70ea-41e2-9197-370581804d09", // Group.ReadWrite.All
    "dbaae8cf-10b5-4b86-a4a1-f871c94c6695", // GroupMember.ReadWrite.All
    "741f803b-c850-494e-b5df-cde7c675a1ca", // User.ReadWrite.All
    "50483e42-d915-4231-9639-7fdb7fd190e5", // UserAuthenticationMethod.ReadWrite.All
    "cc117bb9-00cf-4eb8-b580-ea2a878fe8f7", // User-PasswordProfile.ReadWrite.All
    "8e8e4742-1d95-4f68-9d56-6ee75648c72a", // DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All
    "a402ca1c-2696-4531-972d-6e5ee4aa11ea", // Policy.ReadWrite.PermissionGrant
    "01c0a623-fc9b-48e9-b794-0756f8e8f067", // Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess
    "29c18626-4985-4dcd-85c0-193eef327366", // Policy.ReadWrite.AuthenticationMethod
    "7e05723c-0bb0-42da-be95-ae9f08a6e53c", // Domain.ReadWrite.All
    "292d869f-3427-49a8-9dab-8c70152b74e9", // Organization.ReadWrite.All
    "dd199f4a-f148-40a4-a2ec-f0069cc799ec", // RoleAssignmentSchedule.ReadWrite.Directory
    "fee28b28-e1f3-4841-818e-2704dc62245f", // RoleEligibilitySchedule.ReadWrite.Directory
    "41202f2c-f7ab-45be-b001-85c9728b9d69", // PrivilegedAssignmentSchedule.ReadWrite.AzureADGroup
    "618b6020-bca8-4de6-99f6-ef445fa4d857", // PrivilegedEligibilitySchedule.ReadWrite.AzureADGroup
    "e2a3a72e-5f79-4c64-b1b1-878b674786c9", // Mail.ReadWrite
    "b633e1c5-b582-4048-a93e-9f11b44c7e96", // Mail.Send
    "75359482-378d-4052-8f01-80520e7db3cd", // Files.ReadWrite.All
    "a82116e5-55eb-4c41-a434-62fe8a61c773", // Sites.FullControl.All
    "9492366f-7969-46a4-8d15-ed1a20078fff"  // Sites.ReadWrite.All
)
| join kind=leftouter (
    servicePrincipals
    | where appId == "00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000"
    | mv-expand role = appRoles
    | project permissionId = tostring(role.id), permission = tostring(role.value)
) on permissionId
| summarize permissions = make_set(coalesce(permission, permissionId)), privileged = dcount(permissionId) by displayName, appId
| order by privileged desc, displayName asc

snippets.name: Groups a user is a member of
snippets.description: The groups and other directory objects one user is a direct member of, read one object at a time.
snippets.text:
users
| where userPrincipalName == {upn}
| mv-expand g = memberOf
| where g.objectType == "group"
| project group = tostring(g.displayName), groupId = tostring(g.id), mail = tostring(g.mail)

snippets.name: Members of a group
snippets.description: The direct members of one group, with their type and sign-in name.
snippets.text:
groups
| where displayName == {groupName}
| mv-expand m = members
| project name = tostring(m.displayName), upn = tostring(m.userPrincipalName), type = tostring(m.objectType), id = tostring(m.id)

snippets.name: Owners of an application
snippets.description: The owners of one application registration, with their type and sign-in name.
snippets.text:
applications
| where displayName == {appName}
| mv-expand o = owners
| project name = tostring(o.displayName), upn = tostring(o.userPrincipalName), type = tostring(o.objectType)

snippets.name: Sign-ins from TOR exit nodes
snippets.description: Successful sign-ins from addresses in a threat feed, such as TOR exit nodes. Put one address per line in ips. The default addresses are samples: replace them with a current exit-node list.
snippets.text:
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago({lookback}) and ErrorCode == 0
| where IPAddress in ({ips})
| project Timestamp, AccountUpn, Application, IPAddress, Country
| order by Timestamp desc

snippets.name: Rare process launches
snippets.description: Processes launched only a few times across the fleet in the period, rarest first: candidates for a closer look.
snippets.text:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago({lookback})
| summarize launches = count(), devices = dcount(DeviceId), firstSeen = min(Timestamp), lastSeen = max(Timestamp) by FileName, FolderPath
| where launches <= {maxLaunches}
| order by launches asc, devices asc, lastSeen desc
| take 200

snippets.name: Public storage accounts
snippets.description: Storage accounts that allow public blob access or accept traffic from any network. publicNetworkAccess set to Disabled is not considered, so the list may include accounts that can't actually be reached.
snippets.text:
Resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts"
| where properties.allowBlobPublicAccess == true or properties.networkAcls.defaultAction == "Allow"
| project name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicBlob = properties.allowBlobPublicAccess

snippets.name: VMs without host encryption or a disk encryption set
snippets.description: Virtual machines with neither encryption at host nor a disk encryption set on the OS disk, so only the platform's default storage encryption applies. Limits: Azure Disk Encryption (the extension) is not detected, so VMs encrypted with it are listed; only the OS disk is checked; customer-managed keys set directly on a disk are not seen.
snippets.text:
Resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines"
| extend osDisk = properties.storageProfile.osDisk
| where isempty(tostring(osDisk.managedDisk.diskEncryptionSet.id)) and tostring(properties.securityProfile.encryptionAtHost) != "true"
| project name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, osType = tostring(osDisk.osType), vmSize = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize)

snippets.name: Role assignments at subscription scope
snippets.description: Role assignments made directly on a whole subscription, for the chosen kind of principal. Assignments inherited from management groups are not listed.
snippets.text:
AuthorizationResources
| where type =~ "microsoft.authorization/roleassignments"
| extend scope = tostring(properties.scope), principalType = tostring(properties.principalType)
| where scope matches regex "^/subscriptions/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$"
| where principalType =~ {principalType}
| project subscriptionId, scope, principalId = tostring(properties.principalId), principalType, roleDefinitionId = tostring(properties.roleDefinitionId), createdOn = todatetime(properties.createdOn)
